reviewStandard: All six routes fail the pre-generation compartment, analyte-class, sequencing-workflow, RNA-locus, exact-drug, or succinate-pool evidence gate. They receive no marked prompt, generation call, or raster.
promotionRule: No Batch 091 route is eligible for generation or promotion until its compartment, analyte, workflow, RNA locus, drug exposure, metabolite pool, measurement, endpoint, and evidence conflicts are corrected and independently re-audited.

routeDecisions.reason: Central and peripheral serotonin, estrogens, receptors, microbial pathways, life stages, and multiple clinical phenotypes are merged into one causal axis.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Split by compartment, hormone/metabolite, receptor/enzyme, cell, cycle/life stage, specimen, assay, phenotype, intervention, and evidence tier.

routeDecisions.reason: Distinct acids, sources, sinks, matrices, receptors, concentrations, and context-dependent effects are generalized into universal depletion and metal-disease mechanisms.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Split by exact analyte and matrix with units, processing, method, substrate, organism/pathway, host target, model/population, endpoint, and certainty.

routeDecisions.reason: A multistep sampling, laboratory, sequencing, and computational workflow is presented with universal depth, cost, resolution, kingdom coverage, and direct-function claims.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Define specimen, controls, extraction, library, platform/read type, depth, host depletion, database/version, profiler/assembler, thresholds, outputs, validation, and reporting standard.

routeDecisions.reason: Cis/trans RNAs, sizes, chaperones, mechanisms, organisms, metal conditions, targets, phenotypes, and therapeutic speculation are collapsed into one metal-response mechanism.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Split by organism, locus/sequence/accession, regulator, chaperone, direct target, validated interaction, metal condition/concentration, assay, phenotype, and tier.

routeDecisions.reason: Distinct drugs and exposures plus in-vitro, observational, intervention, and genetic-proxy evidence are generalized into one microbiome, metal, cancer, neurodegeneration, and adverse-effect mechanism.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Split by exact drug, dose/formulation, route, indication, population/model, duration, specimen, microbiome method, pharmacokinetics, comparator, outcome, and tier.

routeDecisions.reason: Host mitochondrial, immune, extracellular, microbial luminal, and brain pools are conflated with universal inflammatory and unsupported Dialister-depression causality.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Define chemical species, compartment, source cell/organism and pathway, concentration/units, sample/assay, receptor/target, model/population, outcome, and tier.
